timecoded_text_to_speech.text: We have been homeschooling for three years and this is our morning routine.
We start at 8.30 each day and are usually done before lunch.
We start with group reading, moving on to math and grammar and independent reading,
and then online work for our history and science.
We also supplement with a few out-school classes once a week for extracurricular classes.
Make sure to check out out-school to see what would fit best in your homeschooling world.
